title: Kompass: know who needs you before the deadline does (pitch)
note: Pitch arc: fear -> pain -> stakes -> turn -> one big hit -> quick proof -> AI answers -> relief -> tagline. App numbers are from the synthetic November 2026 run.

scenes.label: days left to reach German A1
scenes.vo: Every month, a refugee's deadline can quietly run out.

scenes.headline: 160 clients. 11 spreadsheets.
scenes.vo: Not because nobody cared. Their caseworker has a hundred and sixty clients, eleven spreadsheets, and no way to see who is running out of time.
Once the deadline passes, the chance is gone, and so is the funding for the next person who needs help.

captions: Who to call this week, and why.
scenes.vo: Drop in the monthly exports, and every caseworker sees exactly who to call this week, and why.

captions: Local AI reads every intake report.
scenes.vo: A local AI reads the intake reports and spots what is holding people back. Kompass finds goals already reached but never billed, and shows what really works.
And when you have a question, you simply ask.
scenes.app: People are behind on goal 1 because they missed their deadlines without A1 proof: 53 cases.

lines: The right call, at the right time.
Client records never leave the computer.
scenes.vo: No more firefighting. The right call, at the right time. Goals reached, funding secured. And client records never leave the computer.

scenes.headline: Kompass
scenes.sub: Know who needs you, before the deadline does.
